headline: Fuel prices latest: LPG gets a price hike
summary: Fuel prices changed amid exchange-rate fluctuations and Brent crude moves. Following a midnight LPG price hike, gasoline and diesel prices for 4 August 2026 were announced.
why: Fuel prices in Turkey are set by regulated pump-price changes that track Brent crude and the lira, feeding directly into transport costs and inflation.
